step1_figure.circuit_type: Cascode OTA with Class AB Output Stage (Two-Stage Op-Amp)
step1_figure.description: The circuit is a two-stage operational amplifier. The first stage is a cascode OTA (similar to Fig 24.35), and the second stage is a class AB output buffer controlled by a floating voltage source (MFCP/MFCN) to improve drive capability and settling time.

equation.explanation: The total DC gain is the product of the first stage (cascode OTA) gain and the second stage (class AB buffer) gain.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the output buffer is not heavily loaded by a small resistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain A1 ~ gm * (R_ocasn || R_ocasp). Assuming ID=10uA, gm~100uS, Rout~50Mohm -> A1 ~ 5000 (74 dB). Second stage gain A2 ~ 10-30 V/V (20-30 dB). Total gain = 74 + 20 = 94 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact W/L sizing and resulting output resistance (lambda) of the SKY130 devices.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

equation.explanation: The gain-bandwidth product is determined by the transconductance of the input differential pair and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a single dominant pole response created by Miller compensation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming input gm = 100 uS and Cc = 240 fF (from netlist/figures): f_un = 100e-6 / (2 * pi * 240e-15) = 66.3 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales directly with the bias current of the input differential pair.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity-gain frequency, indicating stability.

equation.explanation: Measures how close the amplifier is to oscillating when placed in a closed-loop feedback configuration.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the location of the non-dominant pole (p2 ~ gm_out / C_load). With Cload = 1pF and a class AB output stage, p2 should be sufficiently beyond f_un.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A well-compensated op-amp targets 60 degrees for optimal step response settling.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

equation.explanation: The slew rate is limited by the maximum current available to charge and discharge the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the first stage tail current limits the charging of Cc before the output stage limits the charging of Cload.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a tail current Iss = 20 uA and Cc = 240 fF: SR = 20e-6 / 240e-15 = 83.3 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends entirely on the bias current set by the SUB_1 bias network.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, and phase margin using the built-in AC open-loop RC network (Cbig1, Rbig1).
